How does viscosity affect flow over a body?

No-slip condition at surface
Velocity gradient profile
Thickness of boundary layer
Displacement thickness concept

Laminar flow characteristics

Transition region definition

Skin friction comparison

What factors influence the transition from laminar to turbulent flow?
